scope: radia-mcp release candidate before main integration and push

assessment.summary: The MCP server fleet is in a strong public-facing state, but should not be called operationally complete until PyPI install smoke and release-QUD machine checks pass.

passed_evidence.notes: Public-boundary and repo policy checks were green.
Package metadata and runtime version declarations were consistent.
Generated MCP tool inventory matched the live registry.
Repository-level collection did not expose import drift.

quality_strengths: monorepo packages/radia-mcp consolidation instead of old S:/mcp-server layout

remaining_operational_gates.required_for: claiming released MCP tools start correctly from wheel entry points
claiming operational quality across LAB, 100 machine, mdx, and hibino

remaining_operational_gates.gate: GUI panel and MCP knowledge round-trip
remaining_operational_gates.required_for: claiming the notebook/panel/MCP operating loop is healthy
keeping long-running validation outside fast tests while preserving evidence

release_decision_rule: It is fair to say radia-mcp is healthy and practical. Do not say perfect or fully operational until PyPI entry-point smoke and release-QUD Phase 8/9 checks pass.
